issue_context.title: Add test case in pkg/cm/cpuset to verify no elements are added after result is called
issue_context.body:
This is caught by static check PR
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/103723/files/7e980a3330b648bcc8952356b16fc7500a8c530f#r670801768

Test case needs to be added for the following code path

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/kubelet/cm/cpuset/cpuset.go#L49-#L52

A simple verification of adding element `b.Add()` after result `b.Result()`  is called needs to be added [here](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/pkg/kubelet/cm/cpuset/cpuset_test.go#L38
) 
The test should fail until  PR #103723 is merged.

review_comments: This test seems a bit too coverage-oriented, can we please capture the result and verify the behaviour of add?

> This test seems a bit too coverage-oriented, can we please capture the result and verify the behaviour of add?

This test can pass, but it also can pass without b.Add(). I added this according to #103764. If I remove b.Add(), it should fail, but it doesn't.
